rationale: The persona is pragmatic and favors calibrated, representative checks. Option B validates the judge on a labeled set of persona, ordinary and mixed-style answers, compares its prompt to the published one, and reports precision and recall. This is a broader and more standard reliability check than a hand audit of only positive-scored responses. Option A is more labor-intensive, needing 220 hand-audited responses plus a second rater, and it only looks at positives, so it can't measure recall. Option B fits the persona's preference for a representative, diverse, practical approach better.
